overlap_disclosure.statement: Theo AGENTS.md §6 va RESEARCH_PROTOCOL §5.1: embedding pretrained bang du lieu trich dan/khoa hoc co the da tung thay mot phan corpus/query benchmark; nguy cơ overlap duoc cong bo truoc khi chay benchmark, khong suy dien qua nguon. Overlap khong lam mat hieu luc benchmark neu duoc cong bo va phan tich trung thuc; dense khong phai tin hieu duy nhat vi co BM25 va hybrid RRF.

benchmark_datasets.corpus: 5,183 documents (title+abstract khoa hoc; claims + evidence abstracts; Wadden et al. 2020). Derivation S2ORC cua corpus khong duoc xac minh tu nguon cong khai da truy cap nen khong duoc khang dinh.
25,657 documents (title+abstract); homepage BEIR dan ve SciDocs evaluation suite cua SPECTER (repo allenai/scidocs, co tac vu cite/co-cite)

sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.basis: Model card liet ke S2ORC citation pairs (116.3M abstract pairs + 52.6M title pairs + 41.8M title-abstract pairs) va dataset SPECTER trong training mix (>1B pairs). S2ORC/SPECTER la du lieu van ban khoa hoc quy mo lon; SciFact/SCIDOCS la corpus abstract khoa hoc cong khai cung loai du lieu, nen mot phan van ban corpus co kha nang nam trong tap cap training du card khong liet ke rieng tung van ban (muc trung cu the chua duoc audit).
sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.not_claimed: Khong co bang chung qrels/nhan relevance cua SciFact hoac SCIDOCS duoc dung trong training; khong co bang chung model da thay danh sach query test.

BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5.basis: Card ghi 'large-scale pairs data' khong liet ke dataset; FlagEmbedding README khong liet ke; khong xac minh duoc thanh phan training tu cac nguon da truy cap ngay 2026-09-16.
BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5.not_claimed: Khong khang dinh overlap bang suy dien; khong khang dinh khong overlap.

allenai/specter2_base.basis: Card ghi train tren >6M citation triplets khoa hoc (SciRepEval); 'base model is trained on citation links between papers'. SCIDOCS la benchmark citation-based (homepage BEIR dan ve SciDocs evaluation suite cua SPECTER) nen nguy co trung corpus/citation context cao nhat trong cac ung vien.
allenai/specter2_base.not_claimed: Khong co bang chung qrels SCIDOCS cu the nam trong tap train.

mitigation_and_reporting: Cong bo overlap trong MODEL_CARD.md va config nay truoc bat ky run retrieval nao (SG-019/SG-026/SG-027).
Bao cao overlap trong phan limitation cua bao cao cuoi; khong dung diem dense de tuyen bo chat luong 'tong quat' neu overlap da biet voi benchmark.
Dong encoder co overlap cao (SPECTER2) khong nam trong shortlist core; neu mo sau phai co ADR va bang ket qua rieng.

Chua co kha nang audit tung van ban corpus co nam trong tap training (khong cong bo per-document training membership cua cac model); muc do overlap bao cao la cap do 'nguy co theo tai lieu model card', khong phai do dem chinh xac.

requirements: Encoder phai la multilingual ho tro query tieng Viet -> corpus khoa hoc tieng Anh; encoder tieng Anh cua track A KHONG tu chung minh hieu tieng Viet.
Pin dung mot config: model_id, revision, prefix/prompt, license, overlap disclosure; selection_gate=SG-032 theo protocol tracks.C.multilingual_dense.
Mot fixed config truoc relevance pooling; khong relevance grid; technical dev pilot khong can nhan relevance.
Ung vien da duoc RELATED_WORK RW11 ghi nhan: Multilingual E5 (Wang et al., 2024) la de xuat tham khao, KHONG phai cam ket chon.
Cross-lingual capability phai duoc chung minh qua danh gia tuyen C bang nhan nguoi, khong dua tren diem multilingual tong hop tren web.

unknowns: Danh muc dataset training tieng Anh cua BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 va BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5: khong duoc liet ke trong model card va FlagEmbedding README da truy cap ngay 2026-09-16 -> overlap voi SciFact/SCIDOCS khong xac nhan duoc cung khong loai tru duoc.
So tham so tensor chinh xac cua BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5: chi co '0.1B params' (Safetensors size) tren card.
Pooling va embedding dimension cua allenai/specter2_base: khong duoc ghi tren card (chi ghi nho nhu ung vien bi loai).

Derivation chinh xac corpus benchmark (SciFact tu S2ORC, SCIDOCS tu SciDocs): khong xac minh duoc tu cac nguon cong khai da truy cap (abstract/README/HF dataset card de trong provenance; than bai bao PDF khong fetch duoc) -> overlap duoc bao o muc do nguy co theo model card, khong dua tren derivation da chung minh.
Throughput/latency va VRAM thuc te cua bge-base-en-v1.5 tren T4/CPU: CHUA DO; SG-019 bat buoc chay compute pilot voi model duoc chon (COMPUTE_PLAN §5: khong ngo suy toc do MiniLM sang model SG-017).
Chat luong retrieval thuc te cua tung config: CHUA DO; SG-026 chon tren SciFact dev nDCG@10 theo protocol §8.1. Tai lieu nay khong chua bat ky diem benchmark nao.
